title: Biden Soda
blurb: Compressed past legibility, saturated past recognition, and declared cinema by an internet that had run out of other things to do. This belongs to the deep-fried political absurdism genre, where world leaders turn into surreal meme characters with no policy content attached: just vibes, JPEG artefacts and, in this case, soda. The subject barely matters. It is a real artefact of a particular era of internet humour, when the joke was the processing rather than the subject. Play it as a non-sequitur, or as a small tribute to a period nobody can properly explain any more.
origin: A deep-fried viral clip from the political-absurdism meme genre.
